findings.label: No-ID and stale-state Join flow
findings.finding: The /sessions route has no sessionId param, yet JoinSessionView calls store.fetchSession(undefined) unconditionally; while that invalid lookup loads, 'store.loading && !store.currentSession' selects the loading panel and the join form is hidden. This violates requirement #6 that the form render first when no session ID is pre-populated. Separately, fetchSession records an error but does not clear an existing currentSession, so a failed lookup after another flow populated the Pinia store leaves stale state; hideError then evaluates false, the standalone below-form error panel is suppressed, and the lookup error is shown inside PlayerJoinForm paired with a stale session name.
findings.action: Skip the lookup entirely when no route ID is present so the form always renders. For ID-backed lookups, track lookup failure in a dedicated lookup-error state (or clear prior session state before loading) so fetch failures consistently use the standalone below-form panel while submit failures remain inside the form.

findings.label: Dashboard hero overlay position
findings.finding: HomeView retains the bespoke .hero-heading placed center-right (top: 50%, left: 58%, right: 5%, vertical transform at lines ~242-248). Requirement #1 exempts the Dashboard only from the 240px hero height; it still requires the page title and subtitle to 'always' be positioned bottom-left with 24px padding. The implementer's verification note offers a visual-design rationale, but that is not an approved product exception to the authoritative request.
findings.action: Move the Dashboard title/subtitle to the required bottom-left overlay with 24px padding (consistent with .app-hero__overlay), or obtain an explicit product exception before treating the checklist as complete.
